finding.summary: The new array-rejection rule is applied only to a text element's `data`; every other text-body entry point still repairs an array into a dropped expando — the exact hole the delta claims to close.

But `assertValidTextBody` (line 678) still only guards `!body || typeof body !== 'object'`, so an array passes and reaches `assertValidTextBodyBlocks`, which does `body.blocks = []` on the array (line 715) — dropped by JSON serialization, storing exactly the crashing shape. This path is reached for a shape's `data.text`, and for a table cell's `body` (the other case this same delta touches, line 664). rest-api.md as amended by this diff asserts "no deck is ever persisted in a shape that would be a TypeError for its viewers", so the rule is stated globally but implemented in one branch only.

verdict.reason: The finding checks out against the repository. The array rejection is present only in the `e.type === 'text'` branch of `assertValidElementData` (docs-content.controller.ts:631-635). `assertValidTextBody` (line 678-683) guards only `!body || typeof body !== 'object'`, which an array passes (truthy, `typeof [] === 'object'`), and it then calls `assertValidTextBodyBlocks`, which performs `body.blocks = []` (line 713-717) — an expando on an array that JSON serialization drops. Both cited entry points are reachable: a shape's `data.text` (line 643-645) and a table cell's `body` (line 664-667, in the very block this delta touches at line 661); an array cell also slips through line 769 into `assertValidTextBodyBlocks` at line 770. `writeSlidesRoot` (slides-tree.ts:97-109) stores `slides`/`layouts` verbatim, so the crashing shape is what gets persisted. The spec side is also real: docs/design/rest-api.md:280-290 enumerates a text body's `blocks` and a table cell's `body` under the same repair rule and states the rejection-of-arrays invariant globally ("no deck is ever persisted in a shape that would be a `TypeError` for its viewers"), while the implementation enforces it in one branch only. That is a documented-behavior/implementation conformance gap, in lane for the design-fit lens, and I found no guard elsewhere that makes it unreachable.
